title: Native constructibility of ordinary integral finite local models
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite. Fix an embedding $i:E\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and a normalized coefficient presentation $C$ with its native section functor $S$, as in [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data]. Let $N$ be an ordinary module sheaf over the detailed completed integral coefficient. Restrict N along the fixed projection-normalized completed coefficient comparison of [def-sfb-integral-completed-coefficient-transport]. Suppose this restriction has stratified finitely presented integral constant local models in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models]: some finite locally closed stratification admits pro-etale covering sieves on which it is the completed constant realization of a finitely presented valuation-ring module. If $F$ is a native adic sheaf and $S(F)\simeq\operatorname{pbcExtend}(C.\mathrm{integralMap})(N)$, then F is native adic constructible. Only ordinary sheaves occur; there is no hypothesis or conclusion about derived objects.

proof.text: Take M to be the inverse image of N under the fixed integralSectionFunctor equivalence. Its counit identifies H(M) with N. Transport the given stratified models across this isomorphism, then apply integralSectionLocalModels. Since X is Noetherian, the constant-model predicate is its finite-stratification branch. The proved coefficient-generic helper constructible_of_finiteConstantStratified in IntegralLfpConstantModelComparison converts these constant local presentations into internal constructibility. Only this easy direction is used, not the integral-specific converse.

Compose integralSectionRingIso.hom with C.integralMap and forget the section-ring map to an internal abelian-sheaf map a. Its unit and multiplication identities follow pointwise from map_one and map_mul; hence a is a ring-object map. sectionModuleComapIso, the definition of integralSectionFunctor and pbcRestrictComp give the restriction square Mod.comap(a) followed by H isomorphic to the native section equivalence followed by restriction along C.integralMap. The inverse factors of the section-ring isomorphism cancel.

Take the inverse adjunction mate of the restriction square under the internal and ordinary extension/restriction adjunctions. Both vertical section functors are equivalences, so isIso_inverseMate_of_equivalences makes this mate invertible. Its inverse identifies internal extension followed by native sections with H followed by ordinary extension. Full faithfulness of the native section equivalence, the counit H(M) isomorphic to N and the supplied e lift to an isomorphism between the underlying abelian-module sheaf of F and Mod.extendScalars(a)(M).

Apply the proved ordinary constructible_extend helper in BoundedConstructibleExtendScalars to the internal constructible M. It preserves finite presentations on the same finite stratification and requires no flatness or derived assertion. Transfer constructibility across the lifted isomorphism, and restrict along NativeEncoding.coefficientIso using constructible_comap. Finally encoding_constructible_iff reflects this constructibility to F. These operations also cover empty schemes and strata, zero modules, and torsion local models; no positive-rank choice is made.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof using fixed section equivalences, inverse mates, and already proved ordinary constructibility helpers; no new intermediate obligations.

theorem nativeIntegralCoefficient_heart
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsCommMonObj (abRing l X)]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] PadicAlgCl l) (C : CoefficientPresentation l X E i)
    (N : scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X)
    (hN : IsIntegralStratifiedFinitelyPresented X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u + 1}
        (integralDetailedCoefficientComparison X l E).hom).obj N))
    (F : ProEtale.AdicSheaf l X)
    (e : (sections l X).obj F ≅ (pbcExtend (C.integralMap l X)).obj N) :
    ProEtale.IsAdicConstructibleSheaf F
